_comment: CAVE BIOME VARIETY. Vanilla picks underground biomes by NEAREST box, not containment: dripstone_caves is continentalness >= 0.8 and lush_caves is humidity >= 0.7, so dripstone wins wherever C > H + 0.1. Terra Continental's radial bumps push inland continentalness to ~1.48 (vanilla tops out near 1.0) while humidity keeps its normal range (max ~0.62), so dripstone won almost everywhere underground - only ~8% of land is actually inside its band. The old continent_inland_stretch fix is inert under Tectonic because it hangs off minecraft:overworld/continents, which Tectonic does not use for biome climate. This file is the biome-only hook: Tectonic's version is literally add(full_continents, 0), and full_continents itself must NOT be overridden because initial_density_without_jaggedness, sloped_cheese, roughness and factor/islands all read it - changing it would reshape terrain. The compression is blended in by DEPTH (via tectonic:depth, which follows the terrain rather than cutting a flat plane through mountains) so it is inactive at the surface: surface biomes and terrain are untouched, and only the cave bands see the compressed range. Blend is 0 at depth 0.1 and full by depth 0.3; underground biomes live at depth 0.2-0.9.
